answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The river of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The orchard is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the relic. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing.
